about_the_game:
Watchword is a roguelike deck builder about playing words to beat increasingly difficult trials with rule-breaking synergies and combos. 

A good vocabulary will certainly help, but it will mostly take careful planning and strategy to beat each trial.

Invent crazy new words and use special symbols to play a board that scores massively! Fill your bag and customize your collection of pieces.

Purchase books to ramp up your point scoring. 

Each book has a unique power that can help (or potentially hinder) depending on what pieces you use. Some books completely change the rules of the game. Explore, and discover clever combinations!

Journey through 3 regions to pass the final trial at the top of the city. In your travels you will come across run-changing encounters that will help determine your fate. Will you pass the trials and join the Watchguards?

  • 100+ Unique book relics with unique powers

  • Hundreds of piece variations

  • 20+ Watchguards each with their own set of challenges

  • 30+ run upgrades

  • 100,000+ word base English dictionary 

  • Invent new words that work well with your build

  • Check your stats and shoot for new high scores

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or SteamOS
  • Processor: 2+ Cores, 2+ GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Support for OpenGL 3.3
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ or SteamOS
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM, NVIDIA GTX 970 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Watchword is a roguelike, word-based, deckbuilding game. Strategically use rule-breaking books, point multiplying pieces, and made-up words to score massive points and discover interesting synergies.
